lines.t: It was good, slab riding
Chrome slammer, steel sanctified
This ain't no Sunday Royal jam
It's that trap off the top, you feel me?
Y'all show how much shit the real G from Glory
Ain't no soft line, homie
He the lion and Judah
Texas raised the spirit, you did
Swinging out the mud where the pain still talk
Seen a reaper on the corner, but the cane made him walk
Cross on my neck, not for fashion, that one
He bled for the game, now the devil hit floor
I came from them block where they bang for clout
Now I bang for the name, let that trumpet shout
It's the volumes in my veins, prophecy in the trail
Holy fire in my lung when the big old clap
Ain't no second guess when the lamb got aimed
My cliff was the same, but we stepped in flames
From third wall to heaven, the coast still tight
We gon' ride for the throne till the end of fight

I ain't servin' no crown, but the king mo' high
Y'all sure how my shit, that my solid ride

I got angels on the line with that fire stick
From the block to the book, from the pain to the pee
I ain't playin' church games, this the realest talk
Where the junkies get here, and the killers get caught
My savior ain't pilot, he a boss from dirt
Flip tables on live, make the proud one hurt
We don't tiptoe around the truth and need part

I done seen fiends turn saints overnight
Hold traps, shift gear when the spirit ignite
Ain't no saint too street, no street too gone

Gold grill glow, praise breaks flow
Holy gold lane, when the spirit blow
They flex and chain, we fled redemption
My shout, my plug, great my connection
I don't walk through hell, but my feet stay pure
Had demons in the rearview, masher, yeah, make sure
Ain't no love for fame, no chase for dough
If it ain't kingdom business, then I'm laying low
We swing for the Lord like we swing them doors
Holy drip on slaps, truth bangin' flow
So if you see a thug prayin', don't trip, my friend
He servin' the same king who forgave my sin
From the trenches to the throne, yeah, we swingin' in grace
Blood covered chain breakin', mashia-yakin' space
I ain't servin' no crown, but the king mo' high
Y'all sure I'ma shit, that my side of the rider
The devil won't smoke till I'm pulled up quick
I got angels on the line with that fire
You'll see from the block to the book, from the pain to the pee
When the line dry raw, it's eternal street
Ayy, is that real gospel?
For them boys in 30, for the Southside believers
For them penitentiary prophets and them block preachers
We stand tall, swing wide, kingdom steppin' forever
Yahshua, the lion, king of the age forever
Thank you.
